decision.basis: User-approved bounded closeout: SP01-SP06 preparation deliverables are complete and traceable; the local foundation may begin while product acceptance remains a separate, unpassed gate.
authorizes: Local workspace manifests, lockfile, shared-core skeleton, and web/mini-program placeholder shells.
Local strict checks and builds for the newly created foundation.
doesNotAuthorizeOrClaim: Product business modules, approved product pages, production integrations, cloud deployment, purchases, or release.
Completion of the full QD03 product/launch criterion or any later quality criterion.

preservedLaterGates.trigger: Real product pages and frozen measurement scripts are available.
Actual UI/cloud/supplier endpoints and measured workloads exist; user confirms budgets before the corresponding pass.
Product flows and recoverable test data exist for weak-network/repeat-request scenarios.
Real product pages, approved 60-minute/60-cycle workload, and user-approved measured memory budget are available.
Admin product screens exist and can be measured in the confirmed browser.
Foundation measurement entry, applicable product baselines, and final candidate are available at their assigned stages.
The implemented private-file sharing and revocation flow is available for real permission tests.
Product data, backup points, and a controlled restore/reconciliation case exist.

remoteArchiveExecution.effect: The missing malicious-archive evidence blocks any future re-enablement of remote archive/template execution; the local authored scaffold does not fetch or execute remote templates.
remoteArchiveExecution.remainingRisk: Taro CLI and dependency audit posture are not declared security-cleared; dependency advisories and third-party declaration diagnostics remain recorded for their assigned review and release gates.

limitations: The clean-room copy intentionally contained only manifests, TypeScript configuration, apps, and packages; repository tests were run in the working tree.
npm emitted deprecation/security advisories, including glob@10.5.0 and unsupported legacy dependencies; this is not a dependency security clearance.
Vite emitted its existing CJS/ESM config-loader warning.

sourceScan.limitations: A bounded text-pattern scan only; it is not a secret-scanner or security audit.

workspaceBoundaryGate.scope: AST/static checks for workspace shape, approved source-root imports, shared platform-global and explicit-any references, cross-app imports, cloud deploy/live-SDK wiring, and the boundary-gate-before-bundler build order.
workspaceBoundaryGate.limitations: This is a source-boundary regression gate, not a secret-scanner, dependency audit, security review, or proof against dynamic imports/reflection/runtime behavior.

fullRegression.soleFailure: R01 malicious archive probe evidence is bounded and does not claim cross-platform clearance
fullRegression.failure: The preserved test requires docs/sp01-taro-malicious-archive-20261103.json, which is absent.
fullRegression.disposition: Preserve the failing evidence gate; do not skip, weaken, or claim the suite passed. It blocks future remote archive/template execution per the existing SP01 boundary.

rollback.method: Revert this scoped signoff and the isolated SP07 foundation commit; retain all SP01-SP06 preparation records and historical snapshots.
